signal: FloQast was named to Built In's 2026 Best Places to Work and ranked on the 2025 Deloitte Technology Fast 500 while rolling out AI agent capabilities

email.body1:
Allie, saw FloQast landed on the Deloitte Technology Fast 500 and is rolling out AI agent capabilities to accountants.

Growth that fast usually means more in-market accounts than your inside sales team can cover before reps ramp, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for FloQast off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Allie, quick follow-up for FloQast.

As growth accelerates, pipeline expectations tend to outpace what headcount can cover, and most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to hit the number. The gap shows up late, then it's a scramble to recover the quarter.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings your inside sales team needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Allie, last bit of proof for FloQast.

Memgraph had more accounts in play than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how FloQast's reply rate likely compares to other fast-growing SaaS teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Allie, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Running a growing inside sales team is its own kind of busy, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your inside sales motion? I'll tailor it to FloQast either way.
